2608.30940.title: MusGU+: Toward a Musician-Centered Evaluation Framework and Discovery Tool for Generative Music AI
2608.30940.paper_summary: Generative music systems are increasingly presented as tools that democratize music creation, yet their practical suitability for musicians remains underexplored. Prior work includes openness-focused evaluation frameworks, such as MusGO (Music-Generative Open AI), as well as qualitative studies of musicians' experiences with generative systems. However, these approaches do not support systematic comparison or early-stage discovery of models for creative use. Motivated by such limitations, we introduce MusGU+, a musician-centered evaluation framework organized around three dimensions: Adaptability, Usability, and Controllability. Together, these capture whether a model can be feasibly trained or fine-tuned on personal data, integrated into real-world music workflows, and controlled in musically meaningful ways. We evaluate 10 representative generative music systems and present an interactive discovery tool that enables musicians to explore and filter models according to these criteria. While MusGO remains valuable for promoting responsible research practices, MusGU+ supports informed selection and practical adoption of generative systems by musicians.
2608.30940.paper_summary_zh: 生成音樂系統越來越多地被視為民主化音樂創作的工具，然而它們對音樂家的實際適用性仍然未被充分探索。之前的工作包括以開放性為重點的評估框架，如 MusGO（音樂生成開放人工智慧），以及對音樂家與生成系統互動經驗的定性研究。然而，這些方法並不支持系統性的比較或創意使用模型的早期發現。受到這些限制的啟發，我們介紹了 MusGU+，這是一個以音樂家為中心的評估框架，圍繞三個維度組織：適應性、可用性和可控性。這三個維度共同捕捉模型是否可以在個人數據上可行地訓練或微調、整合到現實世界的音樂工作流程中，以及以音樂上有意義的方式進行控制。我們評估了 10 個具有代表性的生成音樂系統，並提出了一個互動式探索工具，使音樂家能夠根據這些標準探索和篩選模型。雖然 MusGO 在促進負責任的研究實踐方面仍然具有價值，但 MusGU+ 支持音樂家對生成系統的知情選擇和實際採用。
